name: memory_record
description: Store one durable fact (decision, invariant, preference, architecture note, or debug finding), optionally attached to a named entity. Returns observation_id. If that entity already has the identical fact, returns the existing one with status=exists. Enforce the Hard Isolation Rule: record clinical technical prose only, with zero conversational persona names, titles, or stylistic flourishes.

content.description: The fact to remember, as one self-contained sentence or short paragraph.

entity.description: Entity this fact is about (e.g. a service, repo, or host name). Created if missing, matched case-insensitively.

entity_type.description: Entity type. Only applied when not 'concept', or omit to keep the existing type. (Requires 'entity' to be specified).

summary.description: One-line description of the entity (replaces the previous summary). (Requires 'entity' to be specified).

session_id.description: Free-form label (e.g. task or project). A filter label only, not an isolation boundary.

attributes.description: Entity key/values (max 4000 serialized characters), merged with existing ones (JSON Merge Patch: a null value deletes that key). (Requires 'entity' to be specified).
